title:
A {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker} that can handle:
  * pdfs
  * notebooks (ipynb)
  * c3docs
  * c3typs
  * c3 documentation md files
It also (optionally) performs post-processing on the {@link Genai.SourcePassage}s according to the
configs on {@link Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.UniversalChunker.Config}
name: Genai.SourceFile.Chunker.Universal
